question: Can I still get a PGWP if I studied part-time in my final semester?
expected_facts: You may study part-time during your final semester

question: I transferred between two designated learning institutions. Can I still get a PGWP if my studies added up to at least 8 months?
expected_facts: The length of your studies must be at least 8 months

question: Part of my program was an overseas component that earned credit from my Canadian school. Can I still be eligible for a PGWP?
expected_facts: eligible for a PGWP as long as you earn a credit from a Canadian school

question: While I study in Canada, can I work remotely for an employer outside Canada?
expected_facts: You can work remotely for an employer outside Canada
doesn't count towards your 24 hours per week
fact_keys: work remotely for an employer outside Canada

question: I'm in my last semester and only need a part-time course load. Can I still work off campus?
expected_facts: you're in the last semester of your study program and you don't need a full course load

question: Can I pay my restoration fees with a credit card that isn't in my name?
expected_facts: The card you use doesn't have to be in your name
fact_keys: doesn't have to be in your name

question: Can my family submit our visitor visa applications together and use one payment receipt?
expected_facts: submit your applications together ... and use one payment receipt

question: I'm a US citizen. Can I fly to Canada without an eTA?
expected_facts: U.S. citizens are exempt from the eTA requirement

question: Can I bring a holy book of my choice to swear the oath at my citizenship ceremony?
expected_facts: a holy book of your choice, if you want to use it to swear the oath of citizenship

question: My citizenship ceremony is virtual. Can my family watch it in the same room as me?
expected_facts: Your guests can be in the same physical room with you to watch the ceremony

question: My spouse is coming to Canada with me. Can we count money in our joint account as proof of funds for Express Entry?
expected_facts: If your spouse is coming with you, you can count money you have together in a joint account
